notes: Company: mid-market product analytics SaaS, builds embedded product assistants and in-app help.
Primary interest: move from hosted evaluation to Dedicated once latency/cost profile proven.
Workload: real-time chat agents for in-app support and agentic workflows that search product data + take actions (create tickets, run queries).
Latency requirement: 95th pctile < 300ms for token streaming in happy path; sub-500ms end-to-end for single tool call preferred.
POC scope: 2-week seeded traffic POC using Hosted API streaming + function/tool calling; parallel bench to simulate Dedicated throughput.
Key technical concern: tool-call reliability — current infra times out ~2s on some third-party integrations; worried about cascade failures in multi-step agents.
Asked about: streaming stability, chunked responses, websocket vs SSE, retry semantics for tool calls, idempotency, and fallbacks when tools timeout.
Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration; data residency constraint for EU customers (some customers need EU-only storage).
Quote from CTO: "If we lose the ticket creation step due to a tool timeout the whole agent flow collapses — need clear retry/fallback pattern and SLA.
Commercials: wants Hosted pricing for initial months but needs estimate for Dedicated at 3-5x scale; CFO flagged $/token and reserved commit options.
Next tech deep-dive scheduled with SE to demo streaming + multi-tool orchestration and simulated timeouts.
Follow-ups: provide POC runbook, suggested batching/caching config, quantization recommendations for Dedicated, and sample SLA language for latency and availability.
